Hi June, I couldn't set up the recurring 17:30 "Pod end of day" post. The scheduler refused the request because the Gateway needs credentials, and that same error stopped me from checking whether a matching job already exists. Nothing has been created, so there's no risk of a duplicate.

The channel side is fine: you're a member of #strategic-pod, so I can read it and post the digest once scheduling works. The job would run Monday to Friday at 17:30 Chicago time (the Pemberline clock, which is currently 09:00 CDT) and post a "Pod end of day" list of that day's new messages here.

Someone with Gateway admin access needs to fix the scheduler's authentication. Once it's working, I can create the job and run it once as a test, or I can retry now if you'd like.
